description: This Java source file implements an email service class that sends emails with optional attachments using SMTP credentials configured externally. It is part of the Fineract project and handles email messaging within the campaign infrastructure.

classes.name: EmailMessageJobEmailServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of email messaging service that supports sending emails with attachments, configured via external SMTP settings.

methods.name: sendEmailWithAttachment
methods.description: Sends an email with optional file attachments using SMTP credentials fetched from external configuration.

methods.name: getJavaMailProperties
methods.description: Prepares and returns JavaMail properties, configuring STARTTLS, SSL trust, and protocol based on SMTP credentials.
